kitDescription: Rapunzel: Sanctuary is a Fire rocket-launcher Supporter who casts in the second burst stage. Every full-charge shot heals the whole team for a small slice of her own max HP and adds an extra 220.7%-of-ATK hit on the boss. Whenever Full Burst begins she buffs herself, plus any ally currently in an 'Into the Fray' mode (Marian: Queen and Scarlet: Goddeath carry those modes), with Attack Damage up and a flat ATK boost scaled from her own ATK, both for 10 seconds. Her burst skill hands the entire team a flat ATK boost scaled from her ATK for 10 seconds; if three or more allies are down it instead revives them once per battle with much larger buffs, after which her burst cooldown is permanently 40 seconds longer. Holding a full charge for a second raises a shared shield and grants the team DEF, and she ignores any charge-speed increases or decreases from other sources.

redAssertions: VERBATIM file: every non-skipped test fails at 'fixture sanity' because the S5 harness wiring sets opts.onEvent while the harness reads opts.cfg.onEvent — zero events collected, SELF_EV/ATK_BASIS undefined. Mechanical blind defect, not a model divergence; the adapted file (wiring only) is the usable convergence run.

S2-a 'shared shield is damage-inert': shieldStripHits > 0 fails — the driver ships NO shield effect (line UNMODELED: 'Full Charge maintained for 1 or more seconds' has no hold primitive; auto releases at full charge). Blind proxied the hold trigger onto fullCharge — classified RECON_ERROR on the trigger clause; driver's reading matches both S2b reviewers, the SSOT auto-release rule and three precedent overrides.
S2-b 'Goddess Blessing DEF on a ~10s duty cycle': def.length > 0 fails — same unmodeled hold trigger, and defPct is damage-inert. Same classification as S2-a.

S2-d noFb:true counterfactual arm: expects dmgOf(RIDER_NOFB) < base, but an override-level noFb is inert under the default engine (validator rejects it), so the arm reads equal and fails. Blind-test defect; the premise it probes (rider takes the Full Burst +50% by landing time) is pinned directly by the driver's L8 'engine rider defaults' test (fbMajorApplied on every in-window rider hit). Not a divergence.

All other adapted S5 assertions (fixture sanity, S1-a heal→recovery probe, S1-b 27.45 self-only + allies counterfactual, S1-d immunity, S2-c 29.17 flat/self-only, B-b/B-c burstCast-vs-FB-enter inequality, single-branch magnitude) are GREEN against the driver's shipped override.

gotchas.summary: The 'Into the Fray' ally half of both FB-entry grants is dormant in every shipped comp: no override emits a selfStatus whose name starts with 'Into the Fray', so the grants land on her alone today and any comp with marian-queen / scarlet-goddeath under-credits those allies by Attack Damage ▲27.45% + a flat 29.17%-of-her-ATK add at every Full Burst.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Affects self and all allies in the Into the Fray state' (both lines). Driver ⚑1 + caveats; driver's unit test proves the ally half works only by patching marian-queen with a fixture-local battle-start status. S6 flagged the same cross-unit dependency; S2b (both) agreed the gated target is correct and that plain 'allies' would be the worse error.
gotchas.suggestedFix: No change in this override. Have marian-queen's and scarlet-goddeath's overrides emit a battle-start selfStatus named 'Into the Fray: <Mode>' (999s) and name their burst modes in full; the alliesInStatus prefix match then picks them up. Re-run the two-B2 fixture afterwards to confirm the holder set widens.

gotchas.summary: Both 'Full Charge maintained for 1 or more seconds' lines are unmodeled on the premise that auto-play releases at full charge and never holds; if real auto-play does hold for this unit, the shared shield becomes a live tandem channel (shielded triggers / requiresShielded gates) and her per-shot cycle is ~1s longer than the sim's, scaling down her rider and heal cadence.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'maintained for 1 or more seconds … removed when charging ends'. SSOT §4/§7 auto always full-charges and releases; precedent overrides (rapunzel-pure-grace, guilty-mighty-bunny, sin-swift-bunny) unmodeled the same clause. S5/S6 proxied it onto fullCharge (RED vs driver); S6's own flag estimated the proxy over-fires 4–6×.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement: a focus recording of rapunzel-sanctuary under auto with a shield-synergy ally, checking whether the shield icon / Goddess Blessing icon ever appears between shots and timing charge-start → muzzle flash. If she holds, add a charge-hold trigger primitive (time-at-full-charge) — never the fullCharge proxy — and pin the measured cycle; if she does not, close the ⚑3 with the recording.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA survives. The three RED S5 assertions against the shipped override are all attributable: S2-a/S2-b stem from the blind proxying the 'maintained for 1+ sec' hold trigger onto fullCharge, which the prose, the auto-release rule in the SSOT, both S2b reviewers and three precedent overrides all reject, and S2-d's noFb arm is a blind-test defect against an engine-inert flag whose premise the driver pins directly (L8 fbMajorApplied); the verbatim S5 file additionally mis-wires onEvent and collects no events at all. Every damage-bearing line (heal event, both status-scoped FB-entry grants, the 220.7% rider, the burstCast 34.84 team grant, the charge-speed immunity) is byte-identical between the driver and the S6 blind override and is pinned by driver tests that fire at the prose cadence and fail under each named nearest-wrong model (allies/self/burstCast retargets, atkPct basis, immunity removed, core:true, dropped, fullBurstEnter rekey, double branch, +40s passive cooldown) — the S2d vitest log is the independent artifact and is GREEN. Ranked residuals, both documented: (1) the Into-the-Fray ally half is dormant until marian-queen / scarlet-goddeath emit the named status — a cross-unit follow-up the owner should action, since it is where this kit's real support value sits; (2) the charge-hold premise (auto never holds) is a shared prior with a cheap footage check. Same-model residual to spot-check: all four agents accepted the whole-fight statImmunities scope and the auto-release assumption without footage; neither moves the board unless a recording shows her holding charge.
